g.text: Synthetic closed world | Local CPU | 3 training seeds | Not a dedicated-cloud result

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8a3a15

g.text: Primary efficacy not confirmed | NDU minus fixed portfolio: ΔCVaR90 = -0.0152; 95% CI [-0.0426, +0.0094]; required reduction ≥0.020.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Equal-weight means over seeds 17, 29, 43. Worlds per seed: IID 1,536; correlation shift 768; all-shared-wrong 384. CVaR90 is computed within each seed, then averaged; no arm-wise CI plotted.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Panel B counts neural dense-linear MACs only, not total cost: controller, activations, backward, optimizer, I/O and other costs are excluded. Lines only connect observed budgets.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: At budget 4, NDU recursive and NDU myopic coincide. Stress cases expose the shared-error limit; no reliable sensor remains in the all-wrong case.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Source: existing local-preflight-v1_1/summary.json (SHA256 00525e7176e5f661). Observed nondominance is descriptive, not a global or statistically certified efficient frontier.
